"NEON STRIKER (2D Arcade Football)
​Build a polished, visually stunning, self-contained HTML5 Canvas 2D arcade football game optimized specifically for mobile portrait screens.
​1. Visuals @COMMENT_BODY@ Juice (Make it Beautiful):
​Aesthetic: Sleek midnight stadium with glowing neon pitch lines, subtle grid patterns, and vibrant contrasting team colors (Electric Cyan vs. Neon Coral).
​Game Feel @COMMENT_BODY@ VFX: Add glowing motion trails behind the ball, particle explosions on hard kicks and goal impacts, floating \"GOAL!\" banner animations, and subtle camera shake when scoring.
​2. Core Gameplay @COMMENT_BODY@ Physics (Haxball meets Air Hockey):
​Fast-paced 2v2 arcade match (Player + 1 smart AI teammate vs. 2 smart AI opponents) with a 60-second match timer.
​Pure Physics: Smooth top-down momentum physics. The ball bounces naturally off walls and player circles—no magnetic ball-sticking.
​Dynamic Power-Ups: Every 12 seconds, a glowing orb spawns at center pitch giving temporary arcade effects when touched (e.g., Fire Shot for ultra-fast kicks, Speed Boost, or Freeze Rival).
​Proper Kickoff Reset: After every goal, pause briefly for celebration, reset all 4 players to their starting halves, place the ball in the center circle, and resume play.
​3. Mobile Touch Controls (Full-Screen):
​The game canvas must fill 100% of the mobile viewport (100vw, 100vh) with zero scrolling or outer borders.
​Left Thumb: Dynamic virtual joystick for smooth 360-degree movement.
​Right Thumb: Two large, responsive translucent touch buttons:
​KICK: Strikes the ball with power when in range.
​DASH: Quick burst of speed to intercept passes or tackle opponents (with a short visual cooldown ring).
​4. Technical Stability:
​Keep all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript cleanly structured inside a single index.html file with zero external asset dependencies so it builds and runs reliably at 60 FPS on the first try.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

content.text:
Built the complete, self-contained game in **`index.html`**. It fills the viewport and includes a neon portrait pitch, 2v2 momentum-based play, AI teammates and opponents, a 60-second timer, timed power-ups, goal celebrations and kickoff resets, plus a dynamic touch joystick and kick/dash buttons. Keyboard controls are supported too: **WASD/arrow keys** to move, **Space** to kick, and **Shift** to dash.

Verified JavaScript syntax and tested the page in a mobile-sized browser viewport; no page errors were reported. Assumption: teams attack toward opposite ends of the portrait pitch.
